acceptanceCriteria: Reproduction: a new testdata/x/policy.json no longer selects .taskman/policy.json readers
A reader of a relative literal still selects on an exact-path change; unresolvable joins stay UNKNOWN (fail closed), not dropped
body: Found in V1-1762 lane (PR #1112). Adding internal/testvaliditydoc/testdata/external-origins/policy.json made `corvint affected --base 5759396678e6` select internal/tasks/* and tools/cw-trial through PATH_LITERAL_READER on that path, because readers of `.taskman/policy.json` matched by basename. Expected: a path-literal reader is selected only when the changed path can resolve to the literal it reads (full relative path or a declared root join). Actual: basename match over-selects, widening test plans. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/gh-extorigin1762-affected1.json (scratch, may be cleaned).
title: affected: PATH_LITERAL_READER selects readers by basename, so any new policy.json selects readers of .taskman/policy.json
